body:
Cuts Github Actions runtime by removing duplicated work. The time for the tests to pass falls from about 70 minutes to about 50 for ci.yml, and from about 140 to 23 for downgrade.yml. downstream.yml is unchanged at about 80 minutes.

Changes
- ci.yml: on 1.10, only run test group `infrastructure` 
- ci.yml: move the coverage on/off switch into one `COVERAGE` env var (no behavior change)
- runtests.jl: remove `restart.jl` and `unit_reproducibility_infra.jl` from the `restarts` group, since Buildkite already runs both
- downgrade.yml: run only `infrastructure` on 1.10, with coverage off (was about 140 min)
- downstream.yml: run the ClimaCoupler tests only on 1.11
- Update AGENTS.md and docs/clima_atmos_specific.md to match
title: Speed up Github CI

body:
## Purpose 

Apply the `foreach_point` construct to evaluate the `set_cloud_fraction!` kernel. 

Change the way it is evaluated to hold more  data in the registers

## To-do

- [ ] Investigate evaluating `ᶜT′T′ and  ᶜq′q′` inside the kernel
- [x] Pass the `Field`s to the contruct (following https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaCore.jl/pull/2571)

## Content


The `set_cloud_fraction__NVTX` kernel

| State | Register Usage  |   Mean Time           |
|-------|-----------------|-----------------------|
| New   |        121      |      628.586 μs       |
| Old   |        48       |      937.293 μs       |

Just by applying the construct we see good ~30% speedup in the execution time of the kernel. As expected, the register usage increases.  This was measured on the [current `main`](https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaCore.jl/commit/a84e74d5529ca9c0d297cc8309c113257b96ec91) of ClimaCore. 

Currently still DataLayouts are passed in since the lazy broadcasted expression  (ᶜq_lcl and ᶜq_icl) fails (in dispatch chain, the `each_slice_index` wants to take `size` of it which does not work correctly)  


----
- [x]  I have read and checked the items on the review checklist.
title: feat: use foreach_point in `set_cloud_fraction!`
